name: USDJPY Donchian Breakout
description: FX trend-following breakout strategy on USDJPY using 55-day Donchian Channels for entry/exit signals with ADX(14) > 25 trend filter. Long entry on upper band breakout, short entry on lower band breakdown. Exits via opposing Donchian band crossover + hard 1x ATR(14) stop loss. Risk-based sizing at 2% equity risk per trade.
source:
# USDJPY Donchian Breakout Strategy
# =============================================================================
# FX trend-following breakout strategy on USDJPY using 55-day Donchian
# Channels for entry/exit signals with ADX(14) > 25 trend filter.
#
# RULES:
# - Long entry:  Close > Prior bar's 55-day Donchian Upper AND ADX(14) > 25
# - Short entry: Close < Prior bar's 55-day Donchian Lower AND ADX(14) > 25
# - Exit long:   Close < Prior bar's 55-day Donchian Lower Band
# - Exit short:  Close > Prior bar's 55-day Donchian Upper Band
# - Hard stop:   1 × ATR(14) from entry
# - Sizing:      2% equity risk per trade, stop distance = 1 × ATR(14)
# - Long and short
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 55-Day Donchian Channel (highest high / lowest low over 55 days)
donchian = donchian_channel(window=55)(high, low)
upper_band = donchian.donchian_upper
lower_band = donchian.donchian_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high/low contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_band_prior = upper_band >> 1
lower_band_prior = lower_band >> 1

# 14-Day ATR for stop distance
atr14 = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)

# Stop distance = 1 × ATR(14)
stop_dist = atr14

# ADX(14) trend strength filter — lag by 1 to match lagged bands
adx_val = adx(period=14)(high, low)
adx_prev = adx_val >> 1
trending = adx_prev > 25

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY / EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# Raw breakout signals (pulse: true on the breakout bar only via crossover)
long_breakout = close > upper_band_prior
short_breakout = close < lower_band_prior

# Donchian band exits (opposing band crossover)
exit_long_signal = close < lower_band_prior
exit_short_signal = close > upper_band_prior

# Hold breakout state until opposing band exit fires
long_state = hold_until()(enter=long_breakout, exit=exit_long_signal)
short_state = hold_until()(enter=short_breakout, exit=exit_short_signal)

# Apply ADX trend filter — only enter when trending
long_entry = long_state and trending
short_entry = short_state and trending

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long and short zone — entries gated by ADX filter
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Volatility-adjusted position sizing via risk_unit
# Size = (Equity × 2%) / (1 × ATR(14))
# Also provides the hard ATR stop loss (no separate stop_loss needed)
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.pips)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark long breakout entries
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Long Breakout Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(title="Upper Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(title="ADX(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, upper_band_prior, adx_prev, atr14, long_entry)

# Mark short breakout entries
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Short Breakout Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(title="Lower Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
        ColumnSpec(title="ADX(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR(14)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, lower_band_prior, adx_prev, atr14, short_entry)
